trigger.title: Launch Breaks $200
trigger.body: Carrack Heavy posts a third-party price under $200 a kilogram and a weekly flight rate. Orbit starts taking the marginal gigawatt.

decoy.name: The SMR wave
decoy.reason: A wave of reactor orderbooks promises abundant firm power on the ground. The ground does soften in 2039, but because orbit takes the new load, not because reactors arrive.
decoy.tell: Firm Build-out jumps on announcements while delivered firm MW stay flat and Launch Cadence climbs every quarter. The pressure on the ground is coming from above, not from reactors.
